info.timeAllocation: 84 hours online study + 3 hrs offline (2 slots) + 1hr exam + 62 hours self-study
info.description: The skills taught in this Specialization will empower you to succeed in any college-level course or professional field. You’ll learn to conduct rigorous academic research and to express your ideas clearly in an academic format. In the final Capstone Project, all the knowledge that you’ve gained over the span of these courses will culminate into an academic research paper on an issue of your choice.
info.studentTasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)

4. Communicate and discuss in forum

5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional)

6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
info.note:
1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Theoretical Exam (PE)

3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, PE + Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: PE>=4 and FR>=5

clos.loDetails:
After completing this course, students will be able to:
- identify the correct verb tenses to use
- use commas effectively
- utilize several different sentence types
- write more effectively in English

After completing this course, students will be able to:
- create effective thesis statements for essays
- plan and write compare/contrast, cause/effect, and argument essays
- write well-developed body paragraphs

After completing this course, students will be able to:
- plan and write a more sophisticated argument essay
- identify plagiarism and explain how to prevent it
- read and analyze several articles to form students' own opinion on a topic
- make connections between several articles
- form thesis statements from students' readings
- use sources effectively when writing an essay

After completing this course, students will be able to:
- choose appropriate research topics for college classes
- write detailed outlines for research papers
- find and evaluate reliable sources for research papers
- take notes for research
- use academic style and tone
- document sources by creating a Works Cited list in MLA format
- avoid plagiarism

In this capstone project, students will:
- conduct research on an academic topic of their own choice
- create an outline for the research paper
- write a short annotated bibliography
- write a 7-8 page research paper
- use MLA In-text Citations and MLA Works Cited Page correctly

assessments.gradingGuide:

*Analyse an argumentative or a comparative or a cause and effect essay

*'Review a search paper and answer questions (about thesis statement, ideas, paraphrase, reference, etc.)

Part 2: Writing - 60' (70%)

Write 350-400 words on a given topic
assessments.note:
1) The Reading test must clearly cite all sources, and the citations must be authentic and reliable.

2) Students will take the Writing test first, followed by the Reading test.

3) The Writing test must have different topics from those in the Reading test.
